## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ef0b6182918202c0c6147c04836e64f16a27fe21`

### ① Derived judgments

Rendered in-seat by the skills seat 1 session at the served tier the maintainer named on this date (the fable tier word at `get_session` → `external_metadata.last_served_model`, re-read this hour; ruling record 5771798588). The contract is the maintainer's 「1 2 4 同意」 on decision batch #213 item 1, filed by the director seat as the 直派 card's ruled shape (8 items, ⛔ not open for re-design): the four over-500-line published `SKILL.md` split at heading boundaries into routing + rules with every moved block VERBATIM under that skill's `references/` and a one-line pointer left in place; each of the four ≤ 500 lines; `objectstack-data`'s `description` ≤ 700 characters with the trigger phrases and the exclusion sentence kept; a 5–8 line TOC on the seven reference files over 300 lines; the #19714 evals read before and after; ⛔ no new gate; net ≤ +80 lines across `skills/**`; Tier H.

- **(a) Zero content deletion — proved by this seat two ways on a review worktree at the head.** Block by block: the 20 moved blocks (source line ranges at the base → destination ranges, as the PR body tables them) compared line for line — 17 byte-identical, 3 differing only on 8 relative-link retargets (`./rules/…` → `../rules/…`, `./references/x.md` → `./x.md`, `../objectstack-data/…` → `../../objectstack-data/…`) that a moved file needs to keep its links live. Multiset: every line of the four base `SKILL.md` files is present in the after tree (`SKILL.md` + the nine new `references/*.md`) except the retargeted link lines and the rewritten `description` lines — nothing else left the tree; `automation` and `upgrade` lose no line at all.
- **(b) The four readings, re-measured.** `SKILL.md` lines: platform 1223 → 487, automation 961 → 448 (448 after round 1 as well), data 854 → 469, upgrade 600 → 488; the six skills under the line untouched. Net across `skills/**`: +77 (tracked +77 / −1781 against the base, the nine new files +1781; the round-1 pointer edit is +1 / −1) (budget ≤ +80). data's `description`: 1003 → 689 characters by the YAML folded-scalar parse (the card's 1,023 was a different count; either way at the 1,024 cap) — the trigger phrase 「Use when the user is creating or modifying `*.object.ts` files or `src/data/*.ts` seed modules …」 and the exclusion sentence 「Do not use for querying data (see objectstack-query) or for plugin / kernel hooks (see objectstack-platform)」 kept verbatim; the parenthetical enumerations (`defineDatasource`, `defineSeed()`, the retention / rotation / protection list, the CEL contexts) dropped. TOCs: 5 lines on each of the seven files, every anchor resolving to an existing heading under the slug rule (this seat re-derived the slugs; 87 anchors, 0 unresolved).
- **(c) The evals reading, re-run by this seat with the dev's script on the base tree and the head.** No executable runner exists (the fixtures are read only by the token ratchet for pricing), so the reading is mechanical: each `must_contain` term's presence in `SKILL.md` alone and in the skill tree. Tree column 105 / 105 before and after — unchanged for every term. `SKILL.md`-alone 103 / 105 → 85 / 105 (round 0 and round 1 alike — the route spelling is no eval term): the terms that left the entry file each sit behind the pointer on the prompt's path (the PR body tables the 18). Limit stated: substring presence is not a graded run.
- **(d) The token ratchet — read row by row.** The four entry rows re-locked at the landed counts; nine new rows pinned at their landed counts with zero headroom (`bootstrap` 1351, `plugin-development` 3137, `operations` 3125, `examples-flows` 1436, `state-machines-and-approvals` 5569, `examples-objects` 1779, `seeds` 1299, `lint-rules` 970, `examples-upgrade` 1197); four TOC'd rows that carried no headroom RAISED by exactly the TOC's tokens with the ruling cited in the row (`field-types` +126, `dashboards` +162, `list-views` +130, `pages` +191); three TOC'd rows with headroom re-locked downward (`data-hooks`, `relationships`, `validation`) — the dispatch's H3 was wrong about those three. Bundle total 152338 → 154396 (+2058 tokens of pointers, TOCs and H1s); the ceiling sum falls 157621 → 154915. Gate data rows outside `skills/**` followed the text (the ratchet rows; two `role-word` baseline rows relocated with an unchanged total; the scaffold-emission-policy carrier path) — ⛔ no new gate; `skills/README.md` and `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` regenerated by `gen:skill-docs`.
- **(e) The dispatch's route widened by measurement, and the maintainer decides the residue.** Zone 3's cut (the ops tail + two complete examples) reaches only 894 lines on platform, so whole self-contained parts moved (platform Part 2 — plugin development; automation's State Machines & Approvals; data's Seed Data, Field Groups, Linting) and some decision tables now sit behind pointers — listed in the PR body under 「Sections that left SKILL.md」 for the maintainer's word; item 2's 「keeps the rules and decision tables」 could not hold in full at ≤ 500 and the PR says so rather than hiding it.
- **(f) Round 1 — CI red on the first head, this PR's, fixed.** `Test Core (2/6)` failed on 011dfd603: `packages/rest/src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` pins `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` as a TEACHING_SITE of the ledger's canonical route `/api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field`, and the split had moved the only spelling into the reference. Round 1 (`ef0b61829`, one single-parent commit on the same branch, ordinary push): the pointer line for the moved block now ends with the route spelling `GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field?from=:state` — net 0 lines (448 / 500), the reference untouched and still carrying the Introspection bullet, ⛔ no test edit, ⛔ no assertion tuned; the dev measured the test's MENTION / CANONICAL construction on the edited line before running it (one hit, canonical); the automation `SKILL.md` ratchet row re-locked 5762 → 5785 with the pinning test named in the row's comment (a re-lock of a row this same PR lowered by 7,006). The seat re-ran `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest run test:repo` on the patched head: 1 file, 8 / 8 tests green, both formerly red assertions among them; the entry file carries the spelling once, the reference once. The seat grepped every test that reads a published `SKILL.md` (rest, formula ×2, lint ×2, create-objectstack): only this one was red; shards 1 and 3–6 green on the first head.
- **(g) Gates — re-run by this seat on the review worktree after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`.** `check-skills-token-ratchet` 0 (54 authored files within their ceilings) and its self-test 0 (65); `check:skill-refs` (spec) 0 — 9 generated files in sync; `check:skill-docs` 0; `check:skill-identifier-liveness` 0 (456 citations over 53 files); `check:skill-top-level-keys` 0; `check:skill-compatibility` 0; `check:skill-frame-sync` 0; `check:doc-authoring` 0; `check:role-word` 0 (123 occurrences, no new); `check:scaffold-emission-policy` 0; `check:nul-bytes` 0; `bare-root-worklist --self-test` 0; re-run by the seat on the patched head: the token ratchet 0 (`objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 5785 / 5785, headroom 0) and its self-test 0, `check:skill-docs` 0, `check:skill-refs` 0, `check:role-word` 0, `check:scaffold-emission-policy` 0, `check:nul-bytes` 0; the evals reading unchanged; `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 19738` exit 3 — GOVERNED, Tier H (`skills/** ×21`, 3754 changed lines under the human-merge threshold). The dev's derivation: 70 families, `--ran` 70 / 70 / 0 NOT-MEASURED after the declared builds through the verify lock; the spec `check:skill-examples` (258 prose examples) green after the build. CI at the round-1 head at the seat's read: 30 latest-per-name check runs — 12 success, 7 skipped, 11 in progress, 0 other (the round-0 head had shards 1 and 3–6 green and shard 2 red; the 四件套 waits for this head to finish).

### ② Semver level

None — no release. No workspace package's `files[]` ships `skills/` (the dev measured 70 manifests; `packages/cli` ships `bin` as the lit control); `skip-changeset` per the last merged `skills/**`-only PR #19721, written through `label-write.mjs` with read-back.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Tier H** (`skills/**` on the register — the published catalog): draft stays draft; the 四件套 by this seat on green; the maintainer merges by hand after reading 「Sections that left SKILL.md」 — the one judgment this PR leaves to them.
- **Report** 5779508012 (round 0) and 5786717884 (round 1) on the card parse; `mcp_calls` 0; round 0: three pushes, one `POST /pulls`, one label write, one report; round 1: one push, one report; no body PATCH by the dev.
- **Dispatch bookkeeping**: the seat's H3 named the seven TOC'd rows as raises — four raised, three re-locked (headroom existed); the seat's evals H2 method held; the round-0 CI red was caught by the seat's check-run read, not by the dev's local farm (the rest package test runs only in the shard).
- **Out of scope, noted by the dev, ⛔ not touched**: two data eval terms (`schemaMode`, `type: 'secret'`) were reachable only through `rules/` on the base already; `objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` :356 / :448 carry illustrative package-docs links that resolve to nothing — example text.
